name: terra-studio
description: Lets Claude read your Terra Studio channel data (numbers, videos, calendar, ideas) and send approved video ideas to the Ideas tab.
long_description: Reads the files Terra Studio keeps in %APPDATA%\TerraStudio. It can add ideas to an inbox that Terra Studio takes in. It cannot delete, upload or change anything else, and it makes no network calls.

tools.name: get_channel_overview
tools.description: Channel numbers, top and newest videos

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: Every published long video with its stats

tools.name: get_ideas
tools.description: Saved ideas and ideas waiting from Claude

tools.name: check_animal
tools.description: Is this animal already made or planned?

tools.name: add_idea
tools.description: Send an approved idea to the Ideas tab
